rows.note: Use this when “physically” means manually rather than automatically; it is the usual everyday choice in this context.

example.english: We have to enter this form physically rather than have it completed automatically.
example.traditional: 呢份表要用人手輸入，唔可以自動完成。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 biu2 jiu3 jung6 jan4 sau2 syu1 jap6 m4 ho2 ji5 zi6 dung6 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “physically” concerns the body or bodily condition.

example.english: Physically, I’m much healthier now than I was last month.
example.traditional: 以身體嚟講，我而家比上個月健康好多。
example.jyutping: ji5 san1 tai2 lai4 gong2 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 bei2 soeng6 go3 jyut6 gin6 hong1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when the action is done by physical force rather than persuasion or some nonphysical means.

example.english: They physically forced us to hand over the phone.
example.traditional: 佢哋用武力逼我哋交出部手機。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 mou5 lik6 bik1 ngo5 dei6 gaau1 ceot1 bou6 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this only when the statement concerns what the laws of physics allow or entail.

example.english: Physically, this device cannot keep moving forever.
example.traditional: 物理上，呢個裝置唔可能永遠郁落去。
example.jyutping: mat6 lei5 soeng6 ni1 go3 zong1 zi3 m4 ho2 nang4 wing5 jyun5 juk1 lok6 heoi3
